manual_inputs.manual_update_path: Edit config/indicators.json, then run scripts/update_data.py or trigger the GitHub Actions workflow manually.
manual_inputs.manual_update_path_zh: 编辑 config/indicators.json，然后运行 scripts/update_data.py，或在 GitHub Actions 中手动触发更新工作流。

score_policy.name: Core Daily Score
score_policy.description: Automatic daily proxies, explicit-frequency slow variables, and the AI fragility overlay enter the top-risk score. Manual overlay fields are labeled and excluded when missing.

metrics.name: Hyperscaler CapEx QoQ Growth
metrics.note: Combined MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/META cash CapEx proxy. Latest quarter total: 160.6B USD.

metrics.name: Hyperscaler CapEx QoQ Delta
metrics.note: QoQ growth acceleration/deceleration. Negative acceleration is treated as a late-cycle death-signal candidate.

metrics.name: Bank Reserves
metrics.source: auto: FRED WRESBAL / Federal Reserve H.4.1
metrics.note: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks, converted to USD trillions. Lower reserves imply higher liquidity drain risk.

metrics.name: Treasury General Account
metrics.source: auto: FRED WTREGEN / Treasury General Account
metrics.note: Treasury General Account balance, converted to USD billions. Higher TGA can drain private-sector liquidity.

metrics.name: SOFR - ON RRP Spread
metrics.note: Positive SOFR minus ON RRP award-rate spread proxies funding stress.

metrics.name: Standing Repo Facility Usage
metrics.source: auto: New York Fed Markets API repo operations
metrics.note: Accepted SRF tranche amount in recent repo operations. Zero is an observed value when no SRF tranche is used.

metrics.name: 0DTE Stress Share
metrics.note: SPX 0DTE stress-day share. High readings imply short-dated option crowding. Free precise 0DTE share remains unavailable; kept as manual until a stable source is connected.

metrics.name: Call Premium / Call Skew Proxy
metrics.note: Index call-share minus equity call-share. This is a free volume proxy, not an IV-skew truth source.

metrics.name: Core Call Volume Heat
metrics.note: Composite of SPX/SPXW call share and SPX/SPXW share of all Cboe option volume.

principle.summary: AI late-cycle fragility is tracked through hyperscaler capex acceleration, liquidity drain, and options-driven mechanical buying pressure.
principle.use: Use this overlay to upgrade or downgrade top-risk interpretation when price and leverage signals are already elevated.
principle.limits: Liquidity and hyperscaler CapEx now use official free sources. Options crowding still uses free proxies; exact 0DTE share and dealer gamma remain manual or paid-data problems.

ai_capex_cycle.note: Combined reported cash CapEx / productive asset purchases for Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, and Meta. This is a hyperscaler CapEx proxy, not pure AI CapEx.

liquidity_drain.source: FRED CSV and New York Fed Markets API

options_mechanical_bid.note: Free Cboe page proxy. It captures SPX/SPXW call/put volume, not true dealer gamma or exact 0DTE share.

metrics.name: MU 3M Return
metrics.note: Three-month momentum heat.

metrics.name: Distance From 200DMA
metrics.note: Price extension above long trend.

metrics.name: Drawdown From 52W High
metrics.note: Near-high prices leave less margin for disappointment.

metrics.name: MU 1M Return
metrics.note: Short-term acceleration heat.

metrics.name: Latest Gross Margin
metrics.note: Gross profit divided by revenue for the latest standalone quarter.

metrics.name: Revenue QoQ Growth
metrics.note: Standalone quarterly revenue growth. Extreme growth signals capex-chain heat.

metrics.name: Diluted EPS QoQ Growth
metrics.note: Standalone quarterly GAAP diluted EPS growth.

metrics.name: Gross Margin QoQ Delta
metrics.note: Quarterly gross-margin acceleration. A rollover from extreme levels is a canary warning.

metrics.name: HBM Supply Tightness
metrics.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of HBM/advanced memory supply tightness.

metrics.name: Take-or-Pay Intensity
metrics.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of take-or-pay / non-cancelable contract intensity.

metrics.name: Customer Prepayment Intensity
metrics.note: Normalized 0-1 estimate of customer prepayment and commitment intensity.

metrics.name: Trailing GAAP P/E
metrics.note: Low P/E becomes risky when it is paired with extreme margins and EPS surge, because it may reflect peak earnings.

metrics.name: TTM Diluted EPS
metrics.note: TTM GAAP diluted EPS estimated from latest annual plus YTD bridge.

metrics.name: Peak Margin Confirmation
metrics.note: Extreme gross margin confirms that valuation is being measured on unusually strong profits.

metrics.name: Market Liquidity Sensitivity
metrics.note: High-beta AI canaries become more fragile when the broader liquidity-drain overlay rises.

warnings: Micron profits look extreme enough that low P/E may be a peak-earnings trap.
Manual supply-chain inputs imply high demand lock-in and customer urgency.
MU has started to draw down materially from its 52-week high.

principle.summary: Micron is treated as an AI-memory canary: low static P/E is not automatically safe when gross margin, EPS, and demand lock-in are extreme.
principle.use: Watch for divergence: MU price near highs and profits extreme, while cloud capex QoQ growth or memory gross margin acceleration rolls over.
principle.limits: Demand lock-in inputs are manual until a stable contract/deposit dataset is connected.

signals.name: Drawdown Zone
signals.note: Scores whether the pullback is large enough to matter.

signals.name: Price Stabilizing
signals.note: Looks for short-term stabilization after the drawdown.

signals.name: Oversold Rebound
signals.note: Checks whether oversold pressure is starting to reverse.

signals.name: Volatility Easing
signals.note: VIX/VXN easing means forced hedging pressure may be cooling.

signals.name: VIX Term Structure
signals.note: Contango recovery is a panic-normalization proxy.

signals.name: Short Vol Term
signals.note: VIX9D/VIX3M adds a shorter panic gauge when free data is available.

signals.name: Options Skew Cooling
signals.note: Free proxy for put/call and tail-hedge pressure cooling.

signals.name: Rate Easing
signals.note: Checks whether rate pressure stopped worsening.

signals.name: Crypto Stable
signals.note: BTC stabilization proxies high-beta risk appetite.

signals.name: Leveraged ETF Cooling
signals.note: TQQQ/QQQ volume ratio proxies leveraged NASDAQ activity.

signals.name: Breadth Recovering
signals.note: Equal-weight relative strength proxies internal repair.

signals.name: Tech Relative Strength
signals.note: Checks whether NASDAQ leadership is returning.

signals.name: FINRA Margin Cooling
signals.note: Monthly margin debt is lagged 21 days to avoid look-ahead bias.

principle.summary: Bottom readiness rises when a meaningful QQQ drawdown is followed by volatility normalization, rate pressure easing, risk appetite stabilization, leverage cooling, breadth repair, and price stabilization.
principle.use: Use as a staged-entry confirmation tool after a drawdown, not as an exact low predictor.
principle.limits: Dealer gamma, put wall, and CTA flow are represented by public proxies unless paid data is connected.

price.name: QQQ Price Confirmation
price.note: Composite of distance from 200DMA, 3M return, acceleration, and drawdown from 52-week high.

finra_margin_slow.name: FINRA Margin Leverage
finra_margin_slow.note: Authoritative aggregate margin data. Monthly and lagged; used as a slow structural risk variable.

daily_leverage_proxy.name: QQQ Volume Percentile
daily_leverage_proxy.note: Daily QQQ volume percentile over the last 252 trading days.

daily_leverage_proxy.name: TQQQ Volume Percentile
daily_leverage_proxy.note: Daily TQQQ volume percentile over the last 252 trading days.

daily_leverage_proxy.name: TQQQ / QQQ Volume Ratio
daily_leverage_proxy.note: Leveraged ETF activity proxy relative to QQQ volume.
